MBL-producing E. coli isolations are rare in Iran.

the MBL genes are not prevalent in imipenam-resistant E. coli isolated from clinical specimens in Qom.

MBLs are not a common cause of imipenem resistance among clinical E. coli isolations from Qom, and that the blaIMP and blaIMP genes were not detected in our isolates.
